note: Two tiers of number live here, and the app labels every line with which tier it came from. Tier 1 is MEASURED: the monthly utility total comes from Census ACS (median gross rent minus median contract rent) for the listing's own census tract. Tier 2 is ASSUMED: how that measured total splits across heat, electricity and the rest, plus the costs Census gross rent does not cover at all. Assumptions are shown to the user as assumptions.

utility_component_shares._why: ACS gives the utility total but not its breakdown. These shares allocate that measured total so the app can credit what a listing says is included. New England weighting: heating dominates.

utility_term_map._why: Listings name utilities inconsistently. Maps the wording found in real New Haven ads onto the components above.

costs_outside_gross_rent._why: Census gross rent covers rent plus utilities only. These are real monthly costs it never sees, and they are exactly what a first-time renter forgets to add.

internet.applies_when: not listed as an included utility
internet.note: Typical New Haven single-household broadband bill.

laundry.note: Coin or card laundry, roughly two loads a week.

parking.applies_when: renter has a car and parking is not included

furnishing_amortised.applies_when: unit is unfurnished and the renter is arriving from abroad
furnishing_amortised.note: Bed, desk, basic kitchen spread over twelve months. Someone flying in owns nothing.

academic_calendar._why: The quiet cost nobody warns you about. New Haven student leases overwhelmingly run June 1 to May 31, while the academic year starts in late August. Sign the standard lease and you pay for months you are not in the country.
academic_calendar.note: Gap months are charged at full rent and are rarely recoverable unless the unit can be sublet.

pricing._why: For the token cost readout in the app and the report. The app multiplies MEASURED token counts by these rates; it never estimates a cost.
pricing.source: OpenAI Standard pricing per 1M tokens, MGT 409 Lecture 11
